channel.title: OneSchema incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from OneSchema's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: File storage service outage in US [resolved]
Imports failing to submit in US Production [resolved]
item.description: An infrastructure change caused unhealthy nodes that led to imports failing in US production.

item.title: Partial Outage on US Server [resolved]
item.description: We had a temporary outage of our web services that lasted about 5 minutes, starting at 9:40 am PT. All services are back online now and we're monitoring the situation.

item.title: Partial service degradation of the US servers [resolved]
item.description: Service is stable, incident is resolved.

item.title: Partial service degradation of the US servers [resolved]
item.description: All systems are back to normal performance now.

item.title: Partial Outage on US Server [resolved]
item.description: OneSchema has experienced an partial outage on the US server. Total downtime was 23 minutes from 11:45am to 12:08pm PT. An unintentional infrastructure change caused this outage and a fix has been implemented to resolve the issue and prevent it from happening again in the future.
